name: Priyam Sameer
summary: I’m a product leader and former founder working across lending, marketplaces and agritech. I own discovery, strategy, delivery and commercial decisions, connecting customer journeys with the people, integrations and operations needed to make them work.

experience.title: General Manager, Product Management & Business Growth
experience.context: Consumer lending, education-loan journeys, lender partnerships and distribution.

responsibilities.text: I lead lending product strategy and delivery alongside business growth, P&L, lender commercials and operating priorities.
I brought application capture, lender matching and partner operations into a common personal-loan journey, using funnel data and lender feedback to prioritise improvements.
responsibilities.note: Original event definitions and comparison cohorts are not available, so the case study keeps that measurement limit visible.

responsibilities.text: I work with engineering and lender partners on reusable eligibility, KYC, status and payout handoffs, with reconciliation and service-level reviews built into the operating process.

I authored the EduLoans policy model and origination workflow, including 62 rules for eight lenders and 23 workflow states. I built working prototypes to explore verification, document review and the student, partner and account-manager experience.
responsibilities.note: The documented prototypes and proposed feedback work are separate from evidence of production delivery.

highlights: Lead consumer and education lending, from borrower journeys to lender partnerships and P&L.
Join product, growth, engineering and operations around acquisition, application and disbursement.
Promoted from Senior Manager to General Manager in April 2026.
